notes:
Summary: Orion Guardian is evaluating Redwood Private (VPC) for customer-facing knowledge assistant and internal analytics pipelines. Strong requirement: BYOK with HSM-backed keys (FIPS 140-2), support for AWS KMS and Azure Key Vault with key rotation automation and cross-region replication. Wants audit logging exported to their Splunk instance and 7-year retention for crypto operations.

Highlights / call notes:
- 2026-02-18: KMS deep-dive with Diego (SE) & infra team — walked through AWS KMS + Azure Key Vault options. Customer: 'We cannot hand over master keys; BYOK only.'
- Require envelope encryption pattern: customer-managed CMKs for model access tokens and at-rest secrets.
- Must support GCP KMS for some EU workloads (data residency). Need clear mapping of which models/hosts use which KMS.
- HSM ask: provide attestation (FIPS 140-2) and description of HSM boundary for Private deployment.
- Audit: export key rotation and decrypt events (metadata only) to their SIEM; retention 7 years.
- Emergency key-rotation playbook must be documented and tested during PoC.
- Networking: VPC peering + transit gateway path required; offline maintenance windows requested.
- Cost sensitivity: willing to commit to reserved Dedicated nodes if key management integration and SLA acceptable.

POC scope proposals discussed:
- Stage 1: Proof of connectivity & KMS handshake (AWS KMS + BYOK import) — 2 weeks
- Stage 2: HSM attestation docs + audit export to Splunk + rotate test — 3 weeks
- Stage 3: Multi-region replication test (GCP KMS for eu-west) and failover routing — 2 weeks

Stenography / quotes:
- "BYOK or nothing — ops team won't accept platform-managed master keys." (Head of Infra)
- "We need to see sample audit logs, not just 'we keep logs.'" (Head of Security)

Open questions / unknowns:
- Redwood's recommended key rotation cadence and whether Redwood can trigger rotation or if customer-only.
- Clarify whether audit logs include per-request model identity or are aggregated to token-level only.
- Legal wants clause for key escrow (customer prefers no escrow; compliance team pushing for split-escrow).

Attachments & refs: pricing deck (drive link), initial security FAQ stub, sample SIEM mapping sheet.

Next immediate actions (AE / SE):
- Provide architecture sketch that maps AWS KMS / Azure Key Vault usage per workload (Diego) — due 2026-03-08.
- Share HSM attestation template and FIPS evidence (Security eng) — internal doc link.
- Schedule legal + security sync to resolve key escrow constraints (Avery to schedule).
